summary.title: IDEA - nonverbal algorithm assembly instructions
summary.one_liner: A wordless, IKEA-style picture guide that shows how popular algorithms work across cryptography, sorting, graph algorithms and more.
keywords: how do algorithms work without text
takeaways: The series explains popular algorithms using only pictures, with no text.
Topics listed include cryptography, sorting, miscellaneous algorithms and graph algorithms.
Instructions are licensed under Creative Commons for noncommercial sharing and adaptation.
All instructions can be downloaded together as a PDF.
Created by Sándor P. Fekete and blinry; intended for teachers, students and curious learners.
summary.summary: IDEA is a series of wordless, assembly-manual style illustrations that explain how various popular algorithms work. The page lists topic areas including cryptography, sorting, miscellaneous algorithms and graph algorithms. The creators, Sándor P. Fekete and blinry, state that the picture-only format is meant to be understood across cultures. All instructions are available under Creative Commons licenses for noncommercial use, and the full set can be downloaded as a PDF. The page also mentions merchandise (mugs, shirts, posters) sold separately, which is not a technical feature.
